`LFPO.overpass.json`: a small SYNTHETIC answer in the format of Overpass `out geom` (taxiways, stands, gates, holding points, and the cases the launcher job must drop or bound: a repeated point, a one-point taxiway, a relation, a duplicate id, an invalid latitude, a non-numeric id, control characters, a long name, markup in a name). It is not a recording of the public instance: the noreg never calls it.
